sources.title: Uxmal
sources.note: Infobox built 700, Late to Terminal Classic, abandoned 13th century; dedicated in 901 by Chan Chak K'ak'nal Ajaw; Nunnery Quadrangle built 900-1000; Puuc.

notes: NEW STATE, THIN. Cliopatria has no Uxmal row. The page has no Xiu, Mayapan or Chichen Itza history (Chichen Itza appears only as a road destination), no founder and no extent; the Tutul Xiu claim of descent from Uxmal's lineage is on the Mayapan page, not here. 700 (infobox 'built') and 1000 (end of the Nunnery Quadrangle's building span, 900-1000) are bridges; the infobox says 'abandoned 13th century'. Kabah, Sayil and Labna appear only as co-inscribed UNESCO sites and are not dependencies.
